env.name: GMAIL_CLIENT_ID
env.description: The client ID of a Google Cloud OAuth client (type "Desktop app") in a project with the Gmail API enabled. See this ability's README for the five-minute setup.

env.name: GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: A refresh token for the mailbox this agent works in, granted the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify scope (read, label, draft and send). Shared by default; give an agent its own to have it work in a different mailbox.
